summary: This document from Sunrise Health PPO is an Explanation of Benefits (EOB) — it is not a bill. It shows two lab charges from Lakeside Imaging Center for June 12, 2026. Both lines are for the exact same test: a comprehensive metabolic panel (CPT 80053). An automatic check found a problem: the same test appears twice on the same day. This looks like a duplicate charge, which is one of the most common EOB errors. Because of this, do not pay any bill for these charges until the duplicate is sorted out.

lines.explanation: This line is for a blood test called a comprehensive metabolic panel. The EOB shows a $24.00 coinsurance charge — PR-2 means 'this amount is coinsurance, your percentage share of the allowed amount after the deductible is met' [CODE-PR-2]. The $120.00 marked CO-45 is not yours: 'The difference is written off by the provider. Members do not owe CO-45 amounts for in-network care' [CODE-CO-45]. But there is a bigger issue: the code checker found that 'CPT 80053 on 2026-06-12 appears 2 times' — the same test is listed twice on the same day. That looks like a duplicate charge, so hold off on paying anything for this test until the provider explains it.
